# Klavora

Klavora is a modern Pharmacy Inventory Management and FEFO (First Expired, First Out) Automated Dispensing software engineered by EliTech CreaTives Limited. It is designed to modernize pharmacies in Ghana and across West Africa.

## Core Features
- Sub-20ms real-time sync
- FEFO automated batch dispensing
- Offline-first architecture
- HIPAA & Ghana DPA compliant security
- Unified dispensary queue

## Tech Stack
Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
Backend & Infrastructure: Edge computing, real-time sync engines
